title: Oven-Roast Chicken Drumsticks
summary: Kekava Grade A drumsticks, oiled and seasoned, roasted with the oven's core probe to 75 C.

assumptions.note: Package states 1.00 kg, Grade A, use by 20.08.2026. Cook today; do not carry over.

assumptions.text: AEG Competence has no numbered programs
assumptions.note: Rotary-dial oven. Set left dial to True Fan Cooking symbol, not a program number.

assumptions.text: Use oven's built-in core sensor, not surface time
assumptions.note: AEG oven has a core temperature sensor to 99 C; drumsticks are done at 75 C internal regardless of size mix.

assumptions.text: Plain salt, pepper, olive oil rub
assumptions.note: No marinade specified. For more flavour add paprika/garlic; not included here to keep it simple.

tools.name: AEG Competence built-in oven
tools.role: Roasts drumsticks to safe core temp
tools.program: True Fan Cooking symbol, left dial

steps.title: Season drumsticks
steps.do: Pat drumsticks dry with paper towel. Rub with olive oil, salt, and pepper on all sides.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.do: Set the left dial to True Fan Cooking at 200 C and let the oven reach temperature before loading the tray.

steps.title: Roast drumsticks
steps.do: Place drumsticks on the wire shelf over the tray, skin side up. Insert the core sensor into the thickest drumstick, not touching bone, and set it to stop at 75 C.
steps.done: Sensor reads 75 C, juices run clear.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.do: Rest drumsticks on the tray for 5 minutes before serving so juices settle back in.
steps.done: Juices stay on plate, not pooled out.

food_safety: Core temperature must reach 75 C before serving
Wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken
